rubric: A bot repeats that nothing changed; no new argument and no new code.

criteria.activity: Thanks or an acknowledgement, a bot or agent restating what was said, or a change only to CI or configuration

reading.why: A bot repeats that the code is unchanged: no new argument and no new code.

ruledOut.question: activity
ruledOut.label: code
ruledOut.why: A bot repeats that the code is unchanged: no new argument and no new code. It is not code: a real code change: new or rewritten logic, a fix, a new file, or a change of behaviour.

ruledOut.question: activity
ruledOut.label: discussion
ruledOut.why: A bot repeats that the code is unchanged: no new argument and no new code. It is not discussion: an argument, a question, a disagreement or a request that a reviewer should answer.
